subject: general
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 4 5 5 4 3 8 3 2 8 2 4 4 5 8 2 6 4 9 7 8 4 2 2 9 6 1 3 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 4 5 5 4 3 8 3 2 8 2 4 4 5 8 2 6 4 9 7 8 4 2 2 9 6 1 3 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9eb5613202f4a09b6a236cf2928a054058a8bb18d4db6f8497164ffae86bb5d6.png] 

Thus, there are 2 odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
